text_block_list.text:
And the day of the Tenno Sho (Spring) 
arrived—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yoo-hoo♪ Mayano-o!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wah, Teio-chan! Did you come to cheer for 
me~?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Hishiama said she'll sprint right 
over as soon as she's done with her 
errands!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, looks like everyone's looking 
forward to it! Mayano's race, that is!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Look, look, check this out!

text_block_list.name: News
text_block_list.text:
"Tenno Sho (Spring): A Clash of the Top 
Two!?" "Brian vs. Mayano—Who Will Claim 
Victory!?"

text_block_list.name: News
text_block_list.text:
"After the fierce battle at the Hanshin 
Daishoten, onwards to the Shield!" "Who 
will shine brightest: the giant star 
Brian, or the rising star Mayano?!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Nishishi, what's the matter? Starting to 
get nervous~?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
There's no way Maya'd be scared of 
something like that! Jeez, it's actually 
getting Maya super pumped up!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Waah~! As expected of the great Mayano~! 
I'm in awe~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaa! I'll forgive you in exchange for 
some pudding as an apology☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Nihihi. Well then, Trainer-chan, I'm 
heading out!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
This time for sure, I'm gonna get a total, 
flawless victory over Brian-san!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So Trainer-chan, you better look forward 
to it too!
And after sending off Mayano Top Gun—
(Tap, tap)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Hishiama? Mayano already took off, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, you guys. Did you see that video?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wait, is that news about Brian? If so, 
I'll go tell Mayano...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Nah, it's the one that just played a 
moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Regardless, Mayano's Trainer. You'd 
better make sure you check it out.

...On the smartphone that was handed over, 
a news video was playing.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Brian-san, is that true!? Once this Tenno 
Sho (Spring) is over—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'll start making adjustments for 
the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
B-But... the Arima Kinen is in winter, you 
know?! Isn't it far too early to be 
deciding on it now—?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —It is not early.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
There are matters I need to verify. For 
that, I will require some time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Just how far I, Narita Brian, can run...!
